entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay in Benin.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda la estancia en Benín.
entry.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: A visa is required to enter or travel through Benin.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para entrar o transitar por Benín.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to enter or travel through Benin.

entry.en: The visa should be applied for online at least 7 days before arrival and is received on arrival at Cotonou airport.
entry.es: El visado se solicita en línea al menos 7 días antes de la llegada y se recibe al llegar al aeropuerto de Cotonú.
entry.quote: Apply for a Benin visa online at least 7 days before your arrival date. You will get your visa when you arrive at Cotonou airport.

entry.en: Entry visas for Nigeria, Ghana or Togo cannot be obtained in Benin and must be applied for before travelling.
entry.es: Los visados de Nigeria, Ghana o Togo no se pueden obtener en Benín y deben solicitarse antes de viajar.
entry.quote: You cannot get entry visas for Nigeria, Ghana or Togo in Benin.

entry.en: A certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination is required to enter Benin.
entry.es: Para entrar en Benín se exige un certificado que acredite la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: To enter Benin, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: Citizens of all countries may apply for an eVisa online, with 30-day single entry costing 50 euros.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos de todos los países pueden solicitar un eVisado en línea; el de 30 días y una entrada cuesta 50 euros.
entry.quote: Citizens of all countries may apply for eVisa online. Visas can be 30 days single entry (€50)

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Benin, including in places visited by foreigners such as hotels, bars and restaurants.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Benín, incluso en lugares frecuentados por extranjeros como hoteles, bares y restaurantes.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Benin.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to Parc du W National Park, Pendjari National Park and areas within 5km of the border with Burkina Faso.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje al Parque Nacional W, al Parque Nacional Pendjari y a las zonas a menos de 5 km de la frontera con Burkina Faso.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the Parc du W National Park and the connecting hunting zones of Meêkrou and Djona.

safety.en: There is a heightened risk of kidnap in areas bordering the Sahel, including northern Benin.
safety.es: Hay mayor riesgo de secuestro en zonas fronterizas con el Sahel, incluido el norte de Benín.
safety.quote: There is a heightened risk of kidnap in areas bordering the Sahel, this includes northern Benin.

safety.en: Political demonstrations and unrest can occur without warning, and visitors should avoid demonstrations and large crowds.
safety.es: Pueden producirse manifestaciones y disturbios políticos sin previo aviso, y se debe evitar manifestaciones y multitudes.
safety.quote: Political demonstrations and unrest can occur without warning.

safety.en: Street crime, including theft and mugging, is common in Cotonou.
safety.es: Los delitos callejeros, incluidos robos y atracos, son comunes en Cotonú.
safety.quote: Street crime, including theft and mugging, is common in Cotonou.

safety.en: Visitors are advised to avoid walking alone at night and in isolated areas, and never to walk on the beach alone.
safety.es: Se aconseja evitar caminar solo de noche y en zonas aisladas, y no caminar nunca solo por la playa.
safety.quote: avoid walking alone at night and in isolated areas

health.en: The health risks in Benin include yellow fever, malaria and dengue.
health.es: Los riesgos de salud en Benín incluyen fiebre amarilla, malaria y dengue.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in Benin, including:

- yellow fever

- malaria

- dengue

health.en: Medical facilities are poor, particularly in rural areas, and serious treatment may require medical evacuation.
health.es: Los centros médicos son deficientes, sobre todo en zonas rurales, y un tratamiento grave puede requerir evacuación médica.
health.quote: Medical facilities are poor, particularly in rural areas. Emergency medical facilities are extremely limited. For serious medical treatment, medical evacuation is necessary.

health.en: Outside Cotonou there may not be an emergency response, so you may have to arrange transport to the nearest medical centre.
health.es: Fuera de Cotonú puede no haber respuesta de emergencia, por lo que quizá deba organizar el traslado al centro médico más cercano.
health.quote: Outside Cotonou, there may not be an emergency response.

health.en: Malaria is described as a reality in Benin, with mosquitoes active from dusk to dawn.
health.es: Se describe la malaria como una realidad en Benín, con mosquitos activos del anochecer al amanecer.
health.quote: Malaria is a reality in Benin. Mosquitoes appear from dusk to dawn

health.en: In Cotonou the tap water is safe to drink but is treated with chlorine, to which some people may be sensitive.
health.es: En Cotonú el agua del grifo es potable pero está tratada con cloro, al que algunas personas pueden ser sensibles.
health.quote: In Cotonou, the tap water is safe to drink but is treated with chlorine which some people may be sensitive to.

health.en: Street food should be served very hot, because bacteria will not live in hot food.
health.es: La comida callejera debe servirse muy caliente, porque las bacterias no sobreviven en la comida caliente.
health.quote: make sure it is served very very hot, since bacteria will not live in hot food

help.en: The emergency number for fire and ambulance in Benin is 118 and for police it is 117.
help.es: El número de emergencias para bomberos y ambulancia en Benín es el 118 y para la policía el 117.

help.en: Emergency response in Benin is very limited, and you may need to ask for local advice to get emergency help.
help.es: La respuesta de emergencia en Benín es muy limitada y puede que deba pedir ayuda local para recibir asistencia.
help.quote: Emergency response is very limited and you may need to ask for local advice to get emergency help.

getting_in.en: The main international airport is in Cotonou, with flights from cities such as Paris, Brussels, Addis Ababa, Casablanca and Istanbul.
getting_in.es: El principal aeropuerto internacional está en Cotonú, con vuelos desde ciudades como París, Bruselas, Adís Abeba, Casablanca y Estambul.
getting_in.quote: There are many international flights arriving at the main airport in Cotonou.

getting_in.en: There are no international train services to Benin.
getting_in.es: No hay servicios ferroviarios internacionales a Benín.
getting_in.quote: There are no international train services to Benin.

getting_in.en: There are land crossings with all bordering countries, but due to conflict only the two coastal borders with Togo and Nigeria are recommended.
getting_in.es: Hay pasos terrestres con todos los países vecinos, pero por el conflicto solo se recomiendan los dos pasos costeros con Togo y Nigeria.
getting_in.quote: There are land crossings with all bordering countries, but due to conflict, it is only recommended to cross the two coastal borders with Togo and Nigeria.

getting_around.en: Buses run through every major city, and the main systems are Confort Lines and Benin-Routes.
getting_around.es: Hay autobuses que recorren todas las ciudades importantes, y los principales sistemas son Confort Lines y Benin-Routes.
getting_around.quote: The main systems are Confort Lines and Benin-Routes.

getting_around.en: Bus fares are fixed, with Cotonou to Natitingou costing CFA 7,500 and Cotonou to Parakou CFA 5,500 one way.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de autobús son fijas: de Cotonú a Natitingou cuesta 7.500 CFA y de Cotonú a Parakou 5.500 CFA por trayecto.
getting_around.quote: buses running from Cotonou to Natitingou (or vice versa) cost CFA 7,500 one way, and Cotonou to Parakou (or vice versa) costs CFA 5,500

getting_around.en: Bush taxis are available between most cities, but prices must be discussed in advance.
getting_around.es: Hay taxis colectivos entre la mayoría de las ciudades, pero los precios deben acordarse de antemano.
getting_around.quote: Unlike the buses though, prices must be discussed in advance.

getting_around.en: Motorcycle taxis (moto, zemidjan or zem) are the cheapest way to travel within a city, with an average ride costing CFA 100-300.
getting_around.es: Los mototaxis (moto, zemidjan o zem) son la forma más barata de moverse en la ciudad, con un trayecto medio de 100 a 300 CFA.
getting_around.quote: The cheapest way to travel within a city or village is by motorcycle taxi (moto, zemidjan or zem).

getting_around.en: An International Driver's Permit is required to drive in Benin, and traffic drives on the right.
getting_around.es: Para conducir en Benín se exige un Permiso Internacional de Conducir, y se circula por la derecha.
getting_around.quote: If you are planning on driving yourself in Benin, an International Driver's Permit (IDP) is required. Traffic flows on the right hand side of the road.

getting_around.en: As of 2022 the train is not operating in Benin.
getting_around.es: En 2022 el tren no estaba en funcionamiento en Benín.
getting_around.quote: As of 2022, the train is not operating

money.en: The currency is the West African CFA franc (XOF), fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF), fijado en 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: Prices in stores, restaurants, hotels and for bus tickets are non-negotiable, but almost everything else is.
money.es: Los precios en tiendas, restaurantes, hoteles y billetes de autobús no son negociables, pero casi todo lo demás sí.
money.quote: Prices for goods purchased in a store, restaurant, hotel, bus tickets, etc. are non-negotiable, but almost everything else is.

money.en: MasterCard and Visa can be used to withdraw cash at the ATMs of Ecobank, Banque Atlantique, BIBE and SGB.
money.es: Se puede retirar efectivo con MasterCard y Visa en los cajeros de Ecobank, Banque Atlantique, BIBE y SGB.
money.quote: MasterCard and Visa can be used to withdraw cash at the ATMs of Ecobank, Banque Atlantique, BIBE, and SGB.
